description: A daypart whose days_of_week is empty is refused DAYPART_DAYS_INVALID at authoring time. This is the shape that fails SILENT if stored: the row expands to no segments, DAT-073's overlap check vacuously passes it, and the schedule looks configured while scheduling nothing -- no error surfaces anywhere until an operator asks why a screen never entered the window they authored.

errors.message: days_of_week must be a non-empty array of unique integers 0-6 (0 = Sunday); an empty array stores a daypart that covers nothing (DAT-071)
